title: Best Job Description Writers (2026): Clear, Inclusive Job Posts
description: How to hire a job description writer for clear, inclusive job posts that attract the right candidates: what to send, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Job description writers turn a role into a clear, attractive job post: responsibilities, requirements, benefits and what makes your company a good place to work. A good description helps the right people apply and the wrong people self-select out. Problems start when posts list too many requirements, use unclear jargon or exclude candidates without reason. This guide helps you get job descriptions that attract strong, diverse applicants.

faq.q: What should a job description include?
faq.a: The role's purpose, main responsibilities, must-have and nice-to-have skills, location or remote details, and what you offer.
In many places it is expected or required. Check the rules where you hire.
Long enough to be clear, short enough to read on a phone. Bullet points help.

faq.q: How do I make it inclusive?
faq.a: Use plain language, avoid unnecessary requirements and describe flexibility and support honestly.

faq.q: Can they write several roles at once?
faq.a: Yes. A consistent template for all roles saves time and keeps your employer brand consistent.
